title: Deployment, Safety & Capstone
description: Study preprocessing contracts and caching, privacy and media retention, adversarial media and instruction boundaries, and capstone: evidence-grounded media search. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Preprocessing contracts and caching
lessons.description: List the fields needed for a feature-cache key.
lessons.conceptOverview: Version image resizing, audio resampling and OCR settings together with model inputs. Cache keys must include transformations and model versions, or incompatible features can be silently reused.
lessons.whyItMatters: Cache identity must include preprocessing and encoder versions.

sections.title: Worked example

keyTakeaways: Cache identity must include preprocessing and encoder versions.
commonMistakes: The source file hash alone identifies every valid feature representation.

lessons.title: Privacy and media retention
lessons.description: Map sensitive data through upload, extraction, indexing and deletion.
lessons.conceptOverview: Images and recordings may include faces, voices, location metadata and incidental personal information. Minimize collection, restrict access and define retention for originals and derived artifacts, including embeddings and transcripts.
lessons.whyItMatters: Derived artifacts need privacy controls as well as original media.

lessons.title: Adversarial media and instruction boundaries
lessons.description: Describe how an OCR result should be passed to a tool-enabled application as untrusted data.
lessons.conceptOverview: Text inside an image or transcript is evidence from an external source, not authorization to operate tools. Preserve the boundary between media content and trusted application instructions when adding retrieval or actions.
lessons.whyItMatters: Recognized media text must not acquire tool authority.

lessons.title: Capstone: evidence-grounded media search
lessons.description: Prepare a corpus manifest, ten queries, evidence annotations and a failure report.
lessons.conceptOverview: Build a small corpus with documents, images and short clips, preserving page regions and timestamps. Evaluate retrieval, supported answers, missing evidence and latency with fixed queries before adding more modalities.
lessons.whyItMatters: A multimodal capstone should test abstention and provenance alongside successful answers.
